returnTypeNames.reason: These public members return JSON.parse results typed any, so any explicit return type other than any changes the API surface. C2 gives kernel payloads DTO types.

exceptions.reason: Node getters, getReport and markStats return JSON.parse results. C2 decodes kernel payloads in world-graph/codec.ts into validated DTOs.
Polyline create and rebuild assert params['points'] from Record<string, unknown>. C2 gives creation and operation params DTO types.
clone() returns a DisplayClone typed as this. C1 settles the clone contract.
The '__existing' kind returns options.ogId!. D2 removes the '__existing' path.
OpenGeometry.markStats returns the any from markStats(). C2 types mark stats.
exportStep asserts the glue's any result and parses reportJson. C2 types the STEP export DTO.
exportStep stays async so a kernel throw becomes a rejection; removing async changes behaviour and adding an await changes timing. C6 reworks the export contract.
Kernel error JSON, node info and creation results are parsed and asserted. C2 routes every graph call through kernel-session.ts and decodes in codec.ts.
operationParams asserts profile, holes and path from Record<string, unknown>. C2 gives operation params DTO types.
flush asserts the changesSince packet and parses changesJson, and the sync path asserts graph.buffers. C2 types the change feed and display buffers.
requestFor re-reads body.lastInfo after asynchronous steps and asserts shapeId and shapeRevision; a guard would change behaviour. C5 reworks the display loop.
compute asserts graph.buffers, request stays async so a compute throw becomes a rejection, and the no-op members satisfy TessellationProvider. C4 reshapes the provider.
The worker asserts message fields and the tessellator before init. C4 adds message guards.
TessellationProvider is printed as an interface in the API surface through Runtime. C1 removes runtime() from the public surface.
deflectionBucket throws RangeError and GeometryRecord throws Error; an OGError changes the error users see. C2 makes every throw an OGError.
Consumers read getBrep, getReport, the exportStep report and graph() payloads, which are any until C2's DTOs.
The worker probes cast the runtime provider to reach WorkerBackend internals. C4 exposes worker test seams.
The specs read page fixtures from window through asserted fixture types. C7 types the fixtures the pages publish.
